failure_signature: The archive-only full-suite replay failed the inherited v641-v4 tool-integrity rebuild because a Git archive intentionally contains no repository metadata.
trigger_preconditions: full repository suite executed inside a metadata-free Git archive
inherited integrity test compares worktree state with the Git index
recovery: Keep the archive for content-only JSON, manifest, and privacy checks; run the exact-head full suite in one fresh named local validation clone with complete Git metadata.
recurrence_guard: Classify tests by metadata dependency before choosing archive-only replay; use a fresh named clone, never a detached worktree, when the suite contains Git-index integrity assertions.
promotion_effect: The archive-only suite is rejected and is not counted as a successful full replay.
boundary: This is a workflow portability negative, not scientific, security, accessibility, legal, cultural, identity, or independent-reproduction evidence.
